summary: BOTH BUG FIXES VERIFIED via end-to-end Playwright at 414x900 on the public preview URL. (1) Card reveal regression: 6/6 reveals showed full front card (icon + role name + team + description) — confirmed already in iter_7 and re-confirmed today during two full game runs. (2) CRITICAL sniper resolution fix: confirmed resolveNight() now reads from nightActionsRef.current (synchronously updated by updateNightActions in submitSniperChoice) — sniper actions are applied correctly. TEST A (sniper hits mafia_leader): Sniper P1 shot mafia_leader P4 → P4 eliminated with reason 'قنصه القناص / كان: شيخ المافيا'; sniper P1 survived (no 'خرج القناص' entry); mafia kill of citizen P3 also applied correctly with reason 'قُتل من قِبَل المافيا'. TEST B (sniper hits citizen): Doctor protected mafia_leader P4, mafia killed detective P3, sniper P5 shot citizen P6 → end-game screen shows P6 'خرج (قنص القناص)' AND sniper P5 'خرج (قنص مواطن صالح)' (BOTH dead) AND P3 'خرج (قتل المافيا)' AND mafia team wins (3 alive: 2 mafia vs 1 doctor). REGRESSION: Home renders 3 game cards (mafia/cards/domino + soon-1 placeholder); full mafia flow setup→players→roleCounts→distribution→6 reveals→nightStart→nightDoctor→nightMafia→nightSilencer (skip works)→nightDetective+result+dismiss→nightSniper→dayResults→endScreen all transitioned without freeze. 0 page errors during both runs (only style deprecation warnings from RN-Web).
critical_code_review_comments: nightActionsRef pattern (mafia.tsx L124-128) is correctly implemented: updateNightActions() mutates ref synchronously THEN schedules setNightActions for re-render. resolveNight() at L405 reads `nightActionsRef.current` so it never sees stale state regardless of React batching/timing. Verified live: sniperTargetId persisted into resolveNight on the same tick.
ref is properly cleared at startNight (L338) and resetGame (L610), so cross-round/cross-game contamination is prevented.

sniper screen passes ALL alivePlayers (no filter) — correct: sniper can target anyone including mafia. Mafia screen filters to non-mafia (L733) — correct. Sniper himself is NOT filtered out of mafia targets list since sniper.team === 'citizens' — by design sniper can be killed by mafia.

End-screen gracefully handled the case where the game ended immediately after night resolution (mafia gained majority via sniper killing himself + mafia kill) — checkWinner() at L469 ran after setPlayers and routed phase to gameOver, bypassing dayResults. This is correct behavior.

mafia.tsx is now 2039 lines — non-blocking but recommend extracting RevealScreen, NightActionScreen, DayResultsScreen, VotingScreen, EndScreen into /app/frontend/components/mafia/ for maintainability.

RN-Web console warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver fallback) are harmless on web preview but worth migrating to boxShadow/textShadow/style.pointerEvents for forward-compat with newer react-native-web.

Reproducer for sniper test: setup 6 players, roles citizen=1/doctor=1/detective=1/sniper=1/mafia_leader=1/silencer_mafia=1, distribute random, walk all 6 reveals, then night phases with sniper choosing a target via testID `night-sniper-target-{id}` + `night-sniper-confirm`. rca_of_issue: Sniper bug RCA (now fixed): resolveNight() previously read `nightActions` directly from the React state closure. Because submitSniperChoice → setNightActions(...) is asynchronous (React batches state updates and the new state is only visible on the next render), and advanceNightFrom('nightSniper') → resolveNight() ran synchronously within the same tick, resolveNight saw the OLD nightActions value (without sniperTargetId), so the sniper branch never executed and shooting did nothing. FIX: introduced nightActionsRef (useRef<NightActions>) and a helper updateNightActions(patch) that (a) mutates the ref synchronously and (b) schedules setNightActions for UI re-render. resolveNight() now reads `nightActionsRef.current`, which is guaranteed to contain the just-submitted sniper target. Verified on the public preview URL: sniper-hits-mafia and sniper-hits-citizen both produce correct outcomes. Reveal RCA already documented in iter_7.
